description:
Features
 
ID Card
- Create your custom ID Card! Select from a variety of logos or upload your own to make it uniquely yours.

To-do List
- Stay organized and meet deadlines effortlessly with our intuitive to-do list feature. Prioritize tasks, set reminders, and track your progress, ensuring you stay on course and accomplish your goals with ease.

Subto-dos
- Break down tasks into smaller, manageable steps, ensuring better organization and progress tracking.

Course Folders
- Simplify your academic life by effortlessly organizing files for different courses through dedicated folders, ensuring a streamlined and efficient learning experience.

File Organization 
- Effortlessly manage and access course-related files with our dedicated course files feature, providing a streamlined and organized repository for all your academic materials.

Study Sets
- Enhance your study experience by creating personalized study sets, allowing you to efficiently organize and review key information, making exam preparation a structured and effective process.

Bookmark Links
- Easily centralize and access relevant web resources with our course links feature, offering a convenient way to organize and navigate online materials seamlessly within the context of your coursework.

Class Schedule 
- Stay on top of your academic commitments with our class schedule maker, ensuring a well-organized timetable that keeps you on track and maximizes productivity throughout your classes.

Calendar
- Visualize all your to-dos and events in a Calendar view.

Countdown
- Stay prepared by tracking the days left until upcoming events.

Widgets
- Personalize your home screen with our widgets! Stay organized and on top of your schedule with our intuitive and easy-to-use schedule widget.
